summary: Tested the Rive character lip sync over the public URL with the microphone permission granted, during a live ElevenLabs call. Rive loads: State Machine 1 is present with the inputs 'Trigger 1' and 'istracking', and the canvas has about 22k non-transparent pixels, so the character is drawn. While the advisor speaks: body gets the 'speaking' class, [data-testid=operator-mouth] has opacity 1, and --v changes over time (31 samples gave about 30 distinct values from 0.000 to 0.933). The mouth height moves between about 6 and 15.3px. The screenshot shows the mouth sitting on the character's face. While listening: --v is always 0.000 and the mouth opacity is 0 (it fades through 0.2 during the 0.2s transition). 'istracking' is true during the call and false after it. End call goes back to 'Call ended.' / Start call / Offline, with --v at 0 and still 0 one second later (the rAF loop is cancelled). The only console messages are Rive's own WASM streaming fallback warnings and no app errors. Backend regression: 5/5 pytest pass.

issues: Small issue: the CSS mouth overlay is drawn on top of the character's static smile. With a low --v the drawn smile edges can still show around the overlay. This is acceptable.

action_items: Optional: the Rive runtime logs 'wasm streaming compile failed ... falling back to ArrayBuffer instantiation' as console.error. This is harmless, but pinning @rive-app/canvas to an exact version would make it more predictable.
critical_code_review_comments: onConnect calls setLive(true) before startSession resolves, so `conversation` is still null in the first frames. lipSync handles this with the `conversation &&` guard, so it works.
The lipSync rAF keeps running the whole time the call is live, including while listening, and writes --v=0 every frame. A small improvement would be to run it only while mode is 'speaking'.

The idle scale animation (breathe) and the speaking transform are both on the canvas. The mouth is a separate absolutely positioned element and does not scale with the canvas, so there can be a slight misalignment during breathe (about 5%). This is not noticeable.
test_credentials: No auth. ElevenLabs keys are in /app/backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Granting the microphone permission in Playwright is enough to get a live call where the agent speaks first. Sample document.documentElement.style --v every 150ms for about 18s to see both speaking and listening states. The Rive inputs are on operator.stateMachineInputs('State Machine 1').
